newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Feb 25.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Feb 25.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
The World Bank has recommended that Bangladesh should immediately increase the prices of petroleum and fertiliser to boost revenue collection.
World renowned sitarist and composer Pandit Ravi Shanker arrived in Dhaka on Monday at the invitation of Bangladesh government.
The Asian Development Bank (ADB) said the redressing of the macro-economic problems was currently the major challenge facing the government in Bangladesh.
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina on Monday urged the agriculture scientists to develop crops of high yielding varieties that can withstand natural calamities.
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina said on Monday that her government was determined to bring back discipline in the financial and banking sector.
The national flag flies half-mast at all government and semi-government offices in Bangladesh on Tuesday as a mark of respect to the late Chinese leader Deng Xiaoping.
A $192 million project funded jointly by the World Bank and Switzerland was launched on Monday to curb poverty in rural Bangladesh through infrastructural development.
The government has initiated talks with India for sharing of water of the Teesta river, Water Resources Minister Abdur Razzak told the parliament on Tuesday.
